about: Each scenario on the motion demo against each capability of the workbench loop. A cell holds what devharness is expected to do and how that stands today: works, gap, unmeasured or n/a. A cell’s basis is code (read from src/), research:<file> (a report under docs/research/) or sequence:<name> (shown by a run). A cell reads works only on a sequence basis. A capability’s rule applies to every scenario. A scenario’s cell is merged over its mechanism’s default, then its trigger’s, then the capability’s default. A scenario with no key is a case the demo does not stage yet. The conditions behind Credit and Compare stand in docs/landscapes/attribution.landscape.

capabilities.name: Seen
capabilities.question: Does devharness register this motion, and through what?
capabilities.rule: By mechanism: CSS and Web Animations through Chrome's Animation reports; JS writing styles or SVG attributes through a page-side MutationObserver, a run of changes on one element read as one motion; canvas, WebGL and video as a region redrawing per frame, plus the media element's state; SVG <animate> through its begin and end events and the SVG's animation time; smooth scroll through scroll offsets to scrollend; and a style change with no animation reported as changed with no motion.

capabilities.name: Credit
capabilities.question: Which step owns it, and on what evidence?

default.note: A row carries the root of the input that started its chain (page-trigger.ts, root-credit.ts) and is credited to that input's step: a driven input's step is written into the page around its dispatch, a person's input names its History entry, devharness's own scroll takes the step that made it. A reader takes a step once every root credited to it has settled, its work outstanding in the page counted to zero. A row with no root falls back to the step standing when its report arrives and reads as after, not owned; a person's hover, promise continuations past a fetch body read, workers and iframes carry no root yet

capabilities.rule: A motion is credited to the action at the root of its cause, recorded as it starts. A credit names one action, several, or none: two actions that both caused a motion are both named. Each row records its basis: the evidence at capture, a shape across the sequence, code read at a file and line, or a person. A cell reads works when the default credit stands right on root evidence, or when a claim of the basis its expect names puts it right; a row placed by timing alone reads as a gap. What a credit rests on and who may change it: docs/landscapes/attribution.landscape.

capabilities.name: Compare
capabilities.question: Does a replay of the same app read as matched, at any pace and any window size?
capabilities.rule: Measured on sequence:motion-makers-no-waits, the sequence with its waits taken out, so a pass cannot rest on the gaps between steps. A replay is compared by the weight each credit’s evidence carries, so a timing guess and a measured cause count apart; a repeating source is compared as a track, on its start, period and stop, and ambient motion as background against the recording’s background. Cells measured before the comparison reads weights say so in their note.

capabilities.name: Source
capabilities.question: Who made it, and what started it?
capabilities.rule: The row label names the maker: CSS for a transition, keyframes, view transition or scroll timeline; JS for a script that wrote styles or attributes, called animate(), drew or scrolled; SVG for SMIL; MEDIA for a playing video; ME for the person’s own scroll, drag or hover; BROWSER for a scroll the browser makes itself. The go-to opens DevTools on the function or element behind a maker, and History for ME. The opened row holds the trigger chain, headed by the mark of the scenario’s trigger: a key, the end of an earlier motion, a reply, a push, hover or drag, a timer or frame loop, page load, a scroll, or a playback call.

capabilities.name: Solo
capabilities.question: Can it play alone, every other motion frozen?

default.expect: Every other motion frozen while this one plays
default.note: Motion rules act per selector; no rule freezes all but one

capabilities.rule: One motion replays; every other motion freezes where it stood when that one starts.

capabilities.name: Hold and step
capabilities.question: Does hold ui stop it, and hold frame step it?

capabilities.name: Crop
capabilities.question: Which ancestor do its snapshots crop to?

default.note: A held screen is captured from the screencast frame, an element placed by the frame's scroll and kept to its overlap with the screen (sequence:screencast-reads-held-screen); nothing picks the ancestor to crop to. Layout Instability's previousRect and currentRect give up to five shifted boxes (research:motion-detection.md)

capabilities.rule: Snapshots crop to the smallest ancestor holding every box the motion occupied and the elements it shifted. A full-viewport fade that changes only opacity or colour is stated in text, outside the crop.

capabilities.name: Text flag
capabilities.question: What anomaly do the numbers show before any image is taken?

default.note: No anomaly is read from motion values

capabilities.name: Tune
capabilities.question: What can be changed, and how does the change reach the source?

default.note: No live timing edit. Animation.setTiming takes duration and delay only; easing and keyframes need a CSS edit, and DevTools writes the winning declaration with CSS.setEffectivePropertyValueForNode (research:motion-time-control.md)

capabilities.rule: Timing is set live where the mechanism allows; devharness names the rule or code and its line, and the LLM session edits the file.

capabilities.name: Viewport and environment
capabilities.question: Do size, reduced motion or frame rate change it?
